$comment: Pinned so the build does not silently drift onto a newer SDK whose workload manifests
lag behind it — that mismatch fails MAUI builds with NETSDK1147 and is easy to
misdiagnose. Raise this deliberately, together with the workload set.
android sdk    platforms;android-37.0 revision 2 or newer (preview channel:
only TargetPlatformVersion 37.0, and the revision 1 platform that
shipped alongside the preview 6 workload is not the same package.
ANDROID_HOME   must point at the SDK holding android-37.0; the Visual Studio SDK
under Program Files (x86) only has API 35 and 36.
